title: Qimbol qafuuta gorrisaanam
intro: Ayro tawqek naharal, faxe raboyti ardi bagul gexak naharal, wadirih uduur. qarwali faashiin yekkeh suge rammitle mansoofak, malaykootak dagal guddaaqa yeceenih, kee qado maabitina luk diini caxaaxuwih addat daffeysen. Usuk inki waktit, doorit yekke — inkih tan seehadayti baxi aydaadul edde yantifiqe. Ta muuci miyyaay?
clues: Anu gersi marih innah yan gurral geytimam — ardi qandeh addat geytimaah, Gine gabat yan roocih addat geytima.
Anu ixxiga yomcowweh suge tonnal walaa dagal tan malaykoota cakkumsutte.
Inkih yan jannat yok foocal cultam amrisen, inkih culteh — inki num dubuk, kaxxaam ruffa edde iyye.
Anu diini caxaaxuwih addat, amotani raat kee qaynat elle geytima aracal — takkay immay inki diggah waaso luk.
Anu habbaaleeh, anu yewqeeh, anu yewqeh — kee anu inni qellat qilsa yot celta.
Anu yi Rabbi fan afkuuwe sorkocô baxat yoo yooqobeh, usuk yi toobitte oggoleh, usug kaxxa cabsu le.

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
